bias.en: Rebound fading · closed under $340, MACD about to cross down
bias.zh: 反弹乏力 · 收盘跌破 $340，MACD 即将下穿

read.en: Applied Materials fell 3.8% on Nov 19 to $338.93, trading $337.88–367.53 after opening near the high. It is below the 5-day ($352.2), 10-day ($361.3), 30-day ($393.5) and 100-day ($474.7), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($447.2). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($326.97), and RSI is 36.9.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月19日下跌 3.8%，收于 $338.93，开盘接近高点后回落，盘中区间 $337.88–367.53。股价位于 5 日（$352.2）、10 日（$361.3）、30 日（$393.5）和 100 日均线（$474.7）下方，四者均在下行，也低于上行的 200 日均线（$447.2）。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$326.97），RSI 为 36.9。

read.en: The $367.53 high stalled under the $370.5–372.5 closes, and the close broke the $338–343 support, now resistance, the lowest since Nov 6. Resistance is $342.3–343, then $350.3–352.3 (Nov 16 and 18 closes, 5-day) and $358.5–361.3 (Nov 16 high, 10-day). Support is $332.7 (Nov 6 close), then $327–329.3 (SAR, Nov 6 low) and $317–319 (Nov 5). A close above $343 would target $350–352; below $332.7, $327–329.
